title: Logarithmic Schrödinger operators
summary: In this paper we consider the Schrödinger operator $\mathcal L_V= -Δ+ V$ in $\mathbb R^d$ with a non negative potential $V$, and $V\not\equiv 0$. We define the logarithmic Schrödinger operator $\log \mathcal L_V$ proving its main properties. We obtain a pointwise representation of $\log \mathcal L_V$ when $V$ satisfies a reverse Hölder inequality of exponent $q> \frac{d}{2}$ by using the semigroup of operators $\{T_t^V\}_{t>0}$ generated by $\mathcal L_V$.
